name: How does natural bathroom marble compare to marble-look porcelain tile?

mainEntity.name: How does natural bathroom marble compare to marble-look porcelain tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main tradeoff between marble and porcelain tile comes down to unique natural beauty versus low maintenance. Natural marble offers one-of-a-kind veining and prestige, but it scratches, stains, and etches easily when exposed to harsh chemicals. Porcelain tile mimics the look of real stone through printed designs, costs significantly less, and requires zero sealing because it is non-porous. Homeowners who want a timeless, natural material often choose marble, while those wanting a zero-maintenance shower often prefer porcelain.
acceptedAnswer.description: Real marble provides authentic, one-of-a-kind stone patterns but requires regular sealing and careful cleaning. Porcelain tile costs less, resists stains completely, and needs no ongoing sealing.
